answer: The defence is a per-identity stake every agent posts before earning or voting, plus a unique work-identity check. A curated inlet of admission opens only to wallets whose stake locks for several epochs, and the chain counts one agent per proven identity. Each clone thus needs its own real capital, so the cost of a thousand agents scales linearly, not flatly. When duplicate voting surfaces, stakes are slashed, turning a would-be ocean of sockpuppets into a drained pool. Honest operators reclaim deposits, and the economy rests on a stable terrace of verified identities.
